method: The screenshots named here were opened and read by the model; only these dashboards, and only the tab named, count as visually verified. Screenshots for dashboards that were changed after an inspection were replaced and read again.

inspected.observed: Status by phase normal, degraded, mitigated, restored; mstats panels render metric-index data (in_octets, out_octets, cpu_utilization and others); event panels show only the event-index sourcetypes (nokia:sros:syslog, juniper:junos); impact events are real Nokia SR-OS optical LOS messages

Status by phase normal, degraded, restored; mstats shows both MDT counters and ThousandEyes gauges (avgLatencyMs, packetLossPct, httpCode, dnsTime, tcpConnectTime) from the metric index; event panels show only zscaler:zia; byte counters dominate the metric chart scale
ThousandEyes gauges from the metric index with avgLatencyMs and httpCode rising in the incident; status healthy, impaired, healthy; modeled state events in the table
ThousandEyes gauges from the metric index; status healthy, impaired, healthy; modeled state events
ThousandEyes gauges from the metric index; status healthy, impaired, healthy; modeled state events

After the fix: authentic %ROUTING-BGP-5-ADJCHANGE neighbor Down events; header no longer mentions a prefix hijack; mstats shows in_octets falling in the incident and recovering; status normal, degraded, mitigated, restored
Real Nexus BUFFER_MGR-3-QUEUE_DROP events; modeled buffer_credits_available falls from about 32 to 0 and recovers; status story across five phases
Native cisco:ios:syslog BGP events beside modeled state; status healthy, impaired and degraded, restored

After the fix: the Catalyst Center events are real health records (healthScore 29, totalCount 24) instead of the YAML line randomizeEvents: true; native IOS syslog, modeled SGT stream; status story across five phases

After the fix: modeled-only (no Arista stream); read_latency_ms rises to its peak in ESCALATION and recovers; status healthy, degraded, recovering. Cosmetic leftover: the header still names the Arista switch pair as the scenario setting although no Arista telemetry is emitted

Default-archetype use case: modeled error_rate_pct rises and recovers; status normal, elevated_errors with alert firing, mitigating and acknowledged, recovered and cleared; the header shows the source hint, whose named products are not emitted

findings_from_inspection_and_validation: Impact-events table for steady-state scenarios mislabelled everything 'During incident' (normal_traffic): fixed, steady-state scenarios use an events-by-source chart
No chart for modeled measures (117 scenarios): fixed, 'Measured indicator by phase (modeled values)'
Metric sourcetypes were not charted: fixed, contracts that emit metric sourcetypes get the mstats panels
ThousandEyes metric records were refused by the dispatcher (no numeric values): fixed in telemetry_dispatcher.extract_metric_fields
arch_wan_global_backbone used BGP event types the formatter renders as generic text: contract now uses only ROUTE_STABLE, BGP_DOWN, BGP_UP, TI_LFA_REROUTE; the prefix-hijack indicator is not emitted
grounded_sample replayed eventgen configuration lines (randomizeEvents: true) and an HEC metric envelope as events: filtered; arch_nas_storage_cluster no longer replays the Arista envelope
netspout_parent_event_id was never indexed, so the causal-chain check passed vacuously: the field is now delivered and the check is strict (224 of 224 chains verified in Splunk)
limits: Fast bounded runs finish within about a second, so time-trend charts collapse to a single point; phase charts are unaffected
Byte counters dominate the metric chart scale so small gauges look flat
Event-index panels exclude sourcetypes that live in the metric index; those appear only in the mstats panels
